title: Light Irish Couscous Bowl
description: A light, refreshing Irish-inspired dish featuring couscous, marinated vegetables, and a tangy sour cream sauce.

ingredients.name: Caramelized onion
ingredients.notes: caramelized in a pan with 1 tsp olive oil at 4007 for 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: Marinated vegetables
ingredients.notes: marinated in a mixture of 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 1 tsp dried thyme for 30 minutes.

instructions: Cook the couscous according to package instructions using 2 cups water and 1 tsp olive oil at 4007 for 5 minutes.
Caramelize the onion in a pan with 1 tsp olive oil at 4007 for 20 minutes.
Combine the marinated vegetables, sour cream, and bonito flakes in a bowl and mix well.
Add the cooked couscous to the bowl and mix gently.
Top the couscous mixture with mixed greens and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional bonito flakes if desired.
